description: The industry the spot belongs to. With Spot # it is the spot's key (ADR-039).

The industry's name as the waybill cards and the STS seed print it: a copy of its industries.csv name, kept because external/sts-helpers reads this column. www/scripts/tests/test_industry_ids.py checks it matches the id's row.
The spot number within the industry, from 1.
What the spot is used for. One waybill group per industry, usage and car list; Off Spot and Storage get no waybills.
values: Aggregate Unload;Carbon Load;Cement Unload;Chemical Unload;Coal Unload;Crane Track;LPG Unload;Off Spot;Pellet Unload;Shipping Door;Storage;Team Track

description: The car types the spot takes, separated by "; ". Loaded Hopper and Empty Hopper print as Hopper.
